## A figure that takes the document defaults

![A figure with no width or gap attribute.](plot.png){#fig-zero-meta .wrap-right}

A width of zero is not a width, so the metadata width prints a warning and the figure takes the built-in width, 40%. A gap of zero and a breakpoint of zero stay as they are. See @fig-zero-meta.
